name: fitscope
description: Runs and audits the NIRS mitochondrial oxidative capacity pipeline (clean, analyse, plot) for skeletal-muscle recovery-kinetics studies: raw Artinis Oxysoft export -> cleaned 1 Hz dataset -> mVO2 per occlusion with blood-volume correction -> monoexponential recovery time constant Tc. Ships the unmodified reference R pipeline, a pipeline-runner subagent, and a skill that orchestrates both and interprets results against the method's own plausibility guardrails (Ryan et al. 2012 J Appl Physiol; Ryan et al. 2014 J Physiol).
